recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It leaves the substantive applied warning intact while correcting the header name in the active HTTP source; no further core-spec follow-up was identified for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-53546 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6. It requested a dragon warning in the HTTP conditional create section explaining that If-None-Exist searches can race with creates and that servers may check multiple such creates in a transaction for possible collisions.
initial_application: Git commit ee0c7145162a37e8e7b66727df796b9f2caf028a added the requested warning to source/http.html, but preserved a typo from the resolution text: the new collision-check sentence referred to 'if-non-exist creates' rather than the canonical If-None-Exist header.
additional_context: source/http.html is active current-spec source for the RESTful API page, linked from documentation.html and modules-fragment.html. FHIR-I minutes for 2025-12-01 record race-condition discussion and the 6-0-0 Persuasive with Modification motion. Zulip implementer threads about simultaneous If-None-Exist requests support the same risk and did not reveal a conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Changed the warning sentence to say servers may check multiple conditional creates using If-None-Exist headers within a transaction, and removed trailing whitespace on the preceding warning sentence.
source_changes: source/http.html: corrected the transactional-integrity dragon warning from 'if-non-exist creates' to conditional creates using If-None-Exist headers.
